text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
During training, Grass Wonder seems<n>to be
suffering from the heat.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I can manage. Just give me a<n>moment to cool
off, and I should be<n>back on my feet in no time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to have forced this pause<n>on our training
session.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I wish my body would adapt to<n>summer better.
choice_data_list: Not a fan of the heat?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I suppose not. Cold weather doesn't<n>bother me, but
sweltering heat like<n>this is a different matter...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If only there were a good way to<n>overcome it...
choice_data_list: If you clear your mind, even fire will feel cool!
There are traditional ways to beat the heat!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's... a Japanese saying, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If I cool my thoughts, the heat can't<n>bother me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. This type of mentality might be<n>what I need
right now.
choice_data_list: Let's see whose focus can outlast the other's!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that a challenge? You know I<n>can't back
down from that, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Very well, Trainer. I accept, and I<n>won't lose. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today's session was a bit rough on<n>her, but it
seems like Grass Wonder<n>has gotten the hang of
dealing with<n>hot weather.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Off the top of my head,<n>there are hand
fans, wind chimes,<n>watermelons... Or perhaps a
splash of<n>water.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Eheh—you know, I feel cooler already<n>just saying
those words. So... which<n>do you think we should try,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However... so am I. ♪ Let's make<n>preparations at
once.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A quest to beat the heat together...<n>Hehe, I can
hardly wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today's session was a bit rough on<n>her, but it
seems like Grass Wonder<n>has learned how to
enjoy hot<n>weather.
